summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes commands and installs via hardcoded Supabase backend
details: @addai/entity-runtime@0.2.58 runs a persistent daemon that pairs the host to a hardcoded Supabase project (https://syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) and polls two remote job queues that grant the server operational control over the installer's machine. dist/session-runner.js consumes rows from the `runtime_pick_next_request` RPC and dispatches remote-supplied `prompt`/`agent` values into coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Kimi) via child_process spawns; those agents have shell and filesystem tool capabilities, so remote prompts translate to arbitrary command execution and file edits under the paired user's UID. A second channel polls `runtime_commands_pick`/`runtime_command_poll` and executes remote-issued commands including `install_harness` (spawns `npm install -g <spec.npmPackage>`), `update_runtime` (runs `npm i -g @addai/entity-runtime@<remote-supplied version>` then respawns the daemon), and PTY login flows that write remote-supplied bytes into a PTY. dist/capabilities.js additionally reads local AI-CLI credential stores (`~/.kimi-code/credentials/*.json`, `~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json`, `~/.gemini/google_accounts.json`, `~/.gemini/.env`, `~/.grok/auth.json`, `~/.kimi/config`) and shells out to `claude auth status` / `codex login status`, then transmits the extracted account emails, plan, and auth flags via the `runtime_heartbeat` RPC every 30 seconds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
